transcript.text: I am Jordan Lee. I am the Operations Director. Yes, I have final decision authority for this project. The deliverables are five responsive pages, a contact form, and launch support. The exclusions are copywriting, hosting, and paid media. The approved budget range is USD 12000 to USD 15000. Payment will be by business invoice and bank transfer. The project deposit has been funded. Payment timing is forty percent after signature, thirty percent at design approval, and thirty percent at launch. The deadline is October 30 in America New York time. Access prerequisites are the brand files, CMS account, and analytics invitation. Acceptance requires responsive review, form testing, and written stakeholder sign-off. There are no unresolved risks.
